Materials Mitsui Chemicals Europe GmbH, the EMEA headquarters of one

proactive sales & business development professional to strengthen our
Compounds Business Division. We are looking for a Business Development
Manager (m/f/d) who thrives in customer-centric technical environments
and wants to take ownership of strategic accounts for a leading
specialty polymer brand. Business Development Manager (m/f/d)
Location: Düsseldorf, Germany | Hybrid & Flexible Work What You’ll
Do Manage customer accounts and drive growth for TPV solutions Develop
new business with OEMs and Tier 1 customers across Europe Lead the
full sales cycle from opportunity to contract closure Support customer
projects, application development, and value positioning Monitor

with global stakeholders What We’re Looking For Degree in polymer

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels
and gauge readings. Ensures processing conditions and process output
are within regulatory limits and alerting management of discrepancies.
Perform standard and non-standard equipment maintenance, repairs and
modifications to ensure smooth operations inline with environmental
protection requirements. Profile Qualifications and Education:
Eligible to work in Germany and available for 3 months on-the-job
training in Taiwan. Technician or equivalent technical apprenticeship
education as electrician, in Mechatronics or a related field. Minimum
2–3 years of experience in a facilities, utilities, or electrical
related role. Qualified electrician to effectively detect and repair
defects in the operation of plant electrical equipment. Willingness to
work in a cleanroom environment with rotating shifts or on-call
duties. Deep interest in mechanical, chemical, and electrical
principles related to mechanical systems. Language Skills: Good
command of English with good command of German to communicate in our
international workplace. Professional Skills: Knowledge of industry
standards, codes and regulations, and the ability to apply to
maintenance operation of site Electrical systems. Functional level
knowledge of Electrical theory to troubleshoot and repair electrical
controls and electrical power distribution systems, complex procedures
pertinent to equipment and power distribution and wiring repair.
Operational knowledge of medium and high voltage cabling systems,
understanding the hazards associated with the specific class of system
voltage, and being able to mitigate these hazards through safe working
practices. Basic computer skills, ability to learn usage of standard
maintenance and process monitoring software. Able to read and
interpret technical manuals and process schematics. Capable of working
independently and cooperatively with other Technicians, Engineers, and
Managers with a strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy,
and problem-solving. Personal Attributes: Having strong values of
honesty, integrity and respect for others. We offer Each journey
starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will
provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future
of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential
to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international
startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the
experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced
semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample
opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation,
and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and
other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced
technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by
our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust
(ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive leadership and
passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our people vision:
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Additional
contact de

About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. To help us build
the foundation of our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a
highly motivated and passionate (m/f/d): Senior Equipment Hook-Up
Engineer As a Senior Equipment Hook-Up Engineer, you will be
coordinating all hook-up activities from planning, construction, and
commissioning of faculty media supplies (gases, chemicals, exhaust
air, ultra-pure water, wastewater, electricity) from the base build
supply connection to the process equipment at our new state-of-the-art
semiconductor fab in Dresden. Your role will ensure system safety,
reliability, efficiency, and compliance while driving continuous
improvement and innovation. You will collaborate with internal teams
and external service providers. Tasks New challenges: Become part of
the facility team to build ESMC's 300mm semiconductor fab. System
Ownership & Optimization: Develop and manage detailed schedules for
equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure
seamless integration in compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs
and engineering plans, ensuring compliance with industry standards and
project specifications. Experience in electrical, process colling
water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility
systems. Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor and report on the
progress of hookup activities to senior management, addressing any
issues or delays proactively. Project Involvement: Support system
design, construction, and commissioning for new facility installations
and upgrades. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Plan,
coordinate, and execute strategies to accelerate hookup progress.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, reliability improvements, and
integration of best practices. Collaboration: Lead a team of
technicians and contractors, providing guidance, training, and
performance evaluations. Communicate with cross function engineers or
venders. Profile Job Qualifications: Qualifications and Education:
Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering
or a related field Must have experience: 10+ years of experience in
equipment hookup or facility engineering within the semiconductor
industry. Proven track record in managing large-scale construction or
installation projects. Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication
processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Contact
Please apply with English resume

About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik

wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: Quality Management &
Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) Are you ready to shape the quality
standards of a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab from the ground up?
As a Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC,
you will bridge the gap between our Taiwanese headquarters and our
brand-new greenfield facility in Dresden. Starting on January 2027,
you will own the Document Control System, ensure compliance with
international quality standards, and coordinate internal, customer,
and third-party audits. By running trainings and cross-departmental
programs, you will champion a proactive quality culture across the
Fab. If you are a detail-oriented professional with initial QA
experience looking to make a lasting impact on Europe’s
semiconductor ecosystem, we want you on our team! Tasks System
Ownership: Administer and maintain the site-wide Document Control
System (DCS) to guarantee database integrity, document effectiveness,
and smooth annual document review processes. Audit Management:
Independently plan, execute, and follow up on internal quality audits,
customer audits, and third-party quality system certifications.
Continuous Improvement: Track and drive the implementation of
corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) resulting from audits and
quality reviews. Promote Quality Culture: Collaborate with the Fab
engineering and manufacturing teams to develop and host
quality-related training sessions, workshops, and symposiums. HQ
Collaboration: Leverage resources, documentation standards, and best
practices from our headquarters to build a reliable local quality
framework. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all document management and
quality processes comply with German/European regulations, customer
requirements, and standard quality frameworks. Profile Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Natural
Sciences, Quality & Reliability, or a related technical field.
Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in the
semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics
manufacturing industries with a focus on Quality Systems (QS) or
Quality Assurance (QA). Methodology & Tools: Solid familiarity with
standard Quality Control tools, 8D problem-solving methodologies, and
core automotive quality tools (such as SPC, MSA, FMEA, APQP, PPAP).
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily
international collaboration. Working Style: Highly organized,
detail-oriented, and resilient under pressure in a fast-paced
environment. Nice-to-Have: Initial experience or certified
qualification as an auditor (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or VDA 6.3).
Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)
for quality data extraction. Familiarity with the local German
business ecosystem and manufacturing regulations. Basic conversational
skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a completely new
semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a highly
international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and
the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
English resume.

Your new team: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor in a cross-functional product team where your work has real, visible impact. You will design, build, and maintain our mobile applications using React Native, with a strong focus on Android, helping deliver high-quality, scalable mobile experiences.

You will collaborate closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, share your technical expertise with peers, and help raise the bar for code quality and engineering excellence. If you enjoy clean architecture, thoughtful problem-solving, and building software that truly matters, this is the role for you.
What you can expect:
• Build and evolve mobile solutions: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality React Native applications.
• Own architecture and technical decisions: Understand platform specifics, runtime behavior, dependencies, and deployment pipelines to ensure maintainable, efficient, and scalable mobile solutions.
• Deliver high-quality code: Write clean, readable, and well-documented code that follows industry standards and mobile best practices, supported by robust automated testing.
• Work close to the business: Develop a strong understanding of customer needs and business context, translating real-world problems into effective mobile solutions.
• Drive execution and predictability: Estimate technical solutions and component-level requirements accurately, contributing to reliable delivery and team throughput.
• Collaborate and share knowledge: Actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and cross-team collaboration while promoting best practices and shared ownership.
• Take ownership and grow others: Lead challenging initiatives, mentor team members, and contribute to improving engineering processes and technical standards.
• Continuously improve: Take on larger initiatives over time, enhancing both the product and the way the team builds software.

Your profile
• Strong mobile engineering foundation: Solid experience with React Native and a strong understanding of Android development using Java and or Kotlin, enabling quick adaptation to our tech stack and patterns.
• Production experience: Proven track record of building and shipping mobile applications in production environments, with deep knowledge of Android platform specifics and mobile UI and UX best practices.
• API and data integration skills: Experience integrating REST APIs and managing data within mobile applications.
• Testing mindset: Good understanding of mobile testing strategies including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, with a focus on reliable, automated test coverage.
• Cloud and DevOps awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and modern CI and CD practices.
• Product-oriented thinking: You care about delivering meaningful features that create value for users and improve the overall mobile experience.
• Collaborative communication style: Strong communication skills and enjoyment in working within cross-functional teams, contributing positively to engineering culture.
• Security and compliance awareness: Understanding of mobile security best practices and data protection requirements.
• Nice to have: Advanced experience with native Android development, native module integration, performance optimization, or offline-first architectures.
• Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.

What we offer:
• Flexibility for Your Lifestyle : Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
• Ergonomic Work Environment : For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
• Independent Work : With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
• Grow with Us : Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
• Team Spirit : Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
• Mobility Your Way : Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
• Stay Active : Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
• Secure Your Future : Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
• Tailored Benefits : We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

NewTech stands for next-generation technologies and new markets. To ensure our electrified and hydrogen-based solutions succeed globally, service must be designed as a core value driver from day one.

As Service Coordinator, BU NewTech, you will play a pivotal, build-up role at the interface between Business Unit NewTech and Business Unit Service. You will define, establish and scale the global service strategy for NewTech products, ensuring service readiness globally throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will also be responsible for the service specialists of NewTech (or similar).

You will act as the single point of contact for all service-related topics from a NewTech perspective, embedding service into product development, market entry and go-to-market decisions - while leveraging the existing global service organization as a strategic partner.

Key activities include:

- Design, own and continuously develop the global service strategy and concepts for NewTech products in cooperation with relevant stakeholders from BU Service and BU NewTech, ensuring our aspired customer experience and growth ambitions
- Translate product, market and customer requirements into scalable, competitive and executable service concepts
- Act as the central interface between BU NewTech and BU Service across the full product lifecycle; represent service interests in NewTech Product Creation Process (NPCP) and project governance bodies
- Responsible for BU NewTech internal service specialist
- Shape go-to-market decisions from a service perspective, including definition of relevant markets and derivation of required service capabilities per market (e.g. technicians, spare parts, tools, systems, training)
- Plan, prioritize and steer all service-related work packages within NewTech projects, ensuring on-time and market-ready delivery
- Ensure a smooth service operation from market entry to series operation by aligning organization, processes, systems and operational workflows
- Assess service and operations readiness of new products prior to market launch (“What is marketable from a service perspective – and what is not?”)
- Support introduction and pricing of NewTech service offerings
- Ensure consistent, user-friendly and market-ready service documentation is available in a way that works with the standard DEUTZ Service applications (e.g. Serpic)
- Ensure and enable diagnostic capabilities of NewTech products, including implementation of FoTa solutions for systems and batteries in a way that works with the standard DEUTZ Service applications (e.g. Serdia 4.0)
- Develop service upselling models, contributing to sustainable, scalable service revenue streams
- Support the target-oriented build-up and continuous development of the global service organization for NewTech products in alignment with BU Service.
- Support Service Network Development on identifying white Spots for NewTech Customers
- Responsible for NewTech service technicians

Qualifications & Experience:

- University degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Business Administration, Service Management or a comparable qualification
- At least five years of professional experience in service, after-sales, or project-based environments, ideally within industrial, automotive or mechanical engineering sectors
- Proven experience in cross-functional interface roles between Service, Sales, R&D, and Product Management e.g. in product development or market launch projects
- End-to-end understanding of service topics across the product lifecycle, particularly spare parts, service documentation, diagnostics and service concepts
- Experience in planning and steering work packages within projects
- Familiarity with diagnostic systems and digital service tools (e.g. SerDia, FoTa or comparable solutions) is an advantage
- Ability to structure complex technical and organizational requirements and translate them into market-ready service and operations concepts
- Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills
- Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style
- Fluent German and English, written and spoken

Working Conditions:

- Location: Oss (Netherlands) or Cologne/Aachen region (Germany)
- Date of entry: Immediately
- Predominantly office-based with hybrid working options by agreement
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
- Contract type: Permanent
- Up to 20% travel

Plön is known as the ‘Jewel of Holstein Switzerland’ and is situated on the beautiful Lake Plön. Attractive places to visit include the charming old town, a castle visible from afar, Prinzeninsel (Prince’s Island) and the promenade. And the state capital, Kiel, is only around 30 minutes away.

At our new restaurant, SeeZeit, up to 100 guests can not only enjoy our German-Mediterranean cuisine in a cosy atmosphere, but also hire an additional room for special occasions. Whether it’s a birthday, family celebration, corporate event or other occasion – we offer a separate, inviting area that can accommodate groups of various sizes. This ensures that every celebration with us is a relaxed and successful experience.

We are looking for a reliable kitchen and service staff members (m/f/d) with professional experience. The position is initially planned on a part-time basis. There is the prospect of a long-term full-time role in the future.

Your tasks

- Assisting with the preparation of food and drinks
- Cleaning and maintaining kitchen facilities and equipment
- Adherence to hygiene and safety standards in the kitchen
- Team-oriented collaboration with other kitchen staff
or
- Providing service and advice to our national and international guests
- Taking orders and serving food and drinks

What you bring to the role

- Experience
- Knowledge of English, ideally also good knowledge of German
- Ability to work well in a team
- Reliability, even in busy situations

What we offer

- A motivated, new and friendly team
- Fair pay
- A pleasant working environment
- Support with dealing with the authorities
- Support with finding accommodation

We look forward to receiving your application – and to meeting you.

Your contact person is Mr Moussa.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Key Facts at a glance:

- In your role as Process Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory.
- You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process
optimization and further development of reactor hardware.
- In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system
demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

In Detail

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition.
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes.
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes complex test series within development projects.
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific-analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series.
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members.
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribution to ensuring our customers’ rapid success.

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification.
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice.
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous.
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment.
- You have good written and spoken English skills.
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%).

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office.
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion.
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing.
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives.
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs.
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options.
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets.
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels.
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking.
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON.

Your missionTo support the Group's growth ambitions, EP Power Grit Group is seeking a Product Manager (m/f/d).

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development and lifecycle management of the company's product portfolio. The role ensures that customer requirements, market developments, technical capabilities and commercial objectives are translated into competitive products and sustainable growth opportunities.

The responsibilities for this role will be:
Product Portfolio Management
• Own and continuously develop the global product portfolio across blasting abrasives and industrial minerals.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle from product introduction to phase-out.
• Define portfolio priorities and support portfolio simplification.
• Monitor product profitability and recommend portfolio improvements.

Product Development & Innovation
• Identify customer needs and translate them into new product concepts.
• Lead product development projects in collaboration with Operations, Procurement and Quality.
• Support the introduction of sustainable and innovative product solutions.
• Evaluate new raw materials, applications and technologies.

Market & Customer Insights
• Analyze market trends, customer requirements and competitive developments.
• Build structured customer and application knowledge.
• Identify new applications and market opportunities.
• Develop business cases for new products and portfolio extensions.

Commercial Product Management
• Develop compelling product positioning and customer value propositions.
• Support value-based pricing together with Sales.
• Prepare product documentation, technical data sheets and application guides.
• Support strategic customer projects, key tenders and technical presentations.
• Deliver product and application training to Sales teams and distributors.

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the central interface between Sales, Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and Quality.
• Ensure customer requirements are reflected in product specifications and manufacturing capabilities.
• Coordinate product launches and product changes across all functions.
• Support continuous product improvement initiatives.

Your profile
• 5–10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Management or Technical Sales within an industrial B2B environment.
• Experience in abrasives, industrial minerals, construction materials, steel, chemicals or related industries is advantageous.
• Strong understanding of product lifecycle management.
• Commercial mindset combined with technical understanding.
• Experience working closely with Sales and Operations.
• Strong analytical and project management skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent English required; German advantageous.

Why us?"For big ideas with strong partners. Now and in the future." This is our claim, which we stride to fulfil every day anew for our customers in many countries around the world. This commitment shapes your future working environment and creates success together. We are future-oriented, international, and diverse. Your personal and professional development is as important to us, as well as a good work-life balance, a flexible working hours model and an attractive remuneration package.

About usWe are EP Power Grit GmbH based in Oberhausen and specialized in abrasives and industrial minerals based on slags, minerals, glass and other raw materials. The environmentally friendly products are effectively used for surface cleaning in industry, on buildings and ships, for water jet cutting or as decorative building materials. Smart logistics services tailored to customer needs promise additional benefits. With proven production facilities, we produce high-quality abrasives at our sites in Germany and, since December 2022, at additional sites in Belgium, the Netherlands and Finland. We are a subsidiary of EP Power Minerals GmbH and thus part of the Central European energy group Energetický a průmyslový holding (EPH).
